name: Haruuri Card Gamers
original_name: ハルウリカードゲーマーズ
source:
A card game by the name of Magic Monsters is taking the country by storm. Itsuki Nakajou doesn’t have many friends and isn’t passionate about anything, but that all starts to change once he’s introduced to the world of Magic Monsters.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/hustle-battle-card-gamers/]Kagura Games[/url]]
translation:
一款名为《Magic Monsters》的纸牌游戏正在席卷全国。中条树没有很多朋友，对任何事情都不热衷，但一旦他进入魔法怪物的世界，一切都开始改变。

[来自[url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/hustle-battle-card-gamers/]神乐游戏[/url]]
